📊 Dashboard

Get a complete real-time overview of your business performance from a single dashboard. Monitor stock levels, sales activity, supplier bills, customer balances, expenses, taxes, payroll, cash flow, profits, and other important indicators. Interactive summaries and quick insights help management make faster and more informed business decisions every day.

📦 Inventory

Manage inventory efficiently with advanced stock tracking, warehouse management, stock transfers, product categories, serial numbers, and pricing controls. Monitor stock movements in real time, prevent shortages, track adjustments, and maintain accurate inventory records that improve purchasing decisions and overall operational efficiency.

💰 Funds

Track all financial resources including cash accounts, bank accounts, mobile money transactions, loans, investments, and funding sources. Monitor balances in real time, record transfers between accounts, reconcile transactions, and gain a clear understanding of your organization's financial position at any moment.

👥 Customers

Manage customer relationships through invoices, quotations, orders, receipts, credit notes, statements, and payment tracking. Maintain detailed customer records, monitor outstanding balances, review transaction histories, and improve customer service by providing accurate information whenever needed across all business operations.

🚚 Suppliers

Organize supplier information, purchase orders, bills, goods received notes, payments, and debit notes from one centralized system. Improve procurement processes, monitor supplier performance, manage outstanding obligations, and ensure accurate records that support efficient purchasing and inventory management activities.

🧮 Accountant

Access professional accounting tools including manual journals, recurring journals, multi-currency management, account reconciliation, transaction locking, and audit trails. Maintain accurate financial records, improve compliance, simplify bookkeeping procedures, and support informed financial reporting for businesses of all sizes.

💵 Payroll

Automate employee payroll processing with support for salaries, allowances, deductions, taxes, benefits, overtime calculations, and payslip generation. Maintain accurate employee records, reduce administrative workload, ensure compliance with payroll regulations, and simplify workforce management throughout the organization.

📈 Reports

Generate comprehensive financial, inventory, payroll, sales, customer, supplier, and operational reports. Analyze trends, monitor performance indicators, identify opportunities for growth, and make informed decisions using accurate data presented in clear and easy-to-understand reporting formats.

🗂️ Plans

Manage subscription plans, monitor usage limits, control feature access, and track customer subscriptions effectively. View active plans, renewal dates, billing details, and usage statistics to ensure customers receive the correct services while maintaining efficient subscription management processes.

📁 Files

Store, organize, and manage important business documents, backups, attachments, contracts, invoices, and records securely. Access files quickly, maintain proper document organization, support recovery processes, and improve collaboration by keeping essential information centralized and easily accessible.

🤝 CRM

Strengthen customer relationships through lead tracking, opportunity management, follow-ups, communication records, and sales monitoring. Improve customer engagement, increase conversion rates, organize sales activities, and provide teams with tools that support business growth and long-term customer retention.

📧 Email

Send, receive, organize, and manage business communications directly from the platform. Improve communication efficiency, maintain conversation histories, coordinate with customers and suppliers, and streamline workflows by keeping email activities integrated with your daily business operations.

⚙️ Settings

Customize company profiles, warehouses, taxes, currencies, user permissions, costing methods, notification preferences, and system configurations. Adapt the platform to your specific business requirements, improve operational control, and create a working environment that matches your organizational processes.

Powering Smarter Business Operations

Acacia Books is a comprehensive cloud-based ERP platform designed to help businesses simplify operations, improve efficiency, and strengthen financial control. By combining accounting, inventory management, payroll processing, customer relationship management, supplier management, reporting, and workflow automation into one powerful system, organizations gain greater visibility, productivity, and confidence while supporting sustainable growth and long-term business success.

Everything Your Business Needs — In One Platform

Acacia Books centralizes essential business functions into one secure and easy-to-use platform. Organizations can manage inventory, accounting, payroll, customer records, supplier transactions, reporting, and operational workflows without relying on multiple disconnected systems. This unified approach saves valuable time, reduces complexity, improves accuracy, and helps teams work more efficiently every day.

Simplify Daily Operations With Smart Tools

Modern businesses require practical solutions that support productivity and reduce administrative workload. Acacia Books provides tools for managing sales, tracking expenses, monitoring inventory, organizing customer information, and controlling daily business activities. Teams gain faster access to important information, improve collaboration, reduce errors, and maintain operational efficiency across departments.

Why Businesses Choose Acacia Books

Businesses choose Acacia Books because it delivers reliability, flexibility, and powerful management tools within a single integrated platform. The system helps organizations improve productivity, strengthen financial control, automate repetitive processes, and gain valuable business insights while maintaining security, scalability, and ease of use for teams of all sizes.

  • ✔ Cloud-Based & Secure
  • ✔ Easy Setup
  • ✔ Scalable
  • ✔ Dedicated Support Team
  • ✔ Modern Business Platform

Business Insights

Real-time dashboards and advanced reporting tools provide valuable visibility into business performance. Managers can monitor sales trends, inventory movements, customer activity, financial performance, and operational metrics from one location. These insights support better decision-making, improve forecasting accuracy, optimize resources, and help organizations achieve strategic objectives more effectively.

Our Apps

Access all your business applications in one unified platform designed for speed, automation, and real-time control. Manage operations from anywhere, reduce manual work, improve productivity, and stay connected to your business activities through smart digital tools built to support growth, accuracy, and efficient decision-making across all departments.

Inventory

Inventory management helps businesses track stock levels, monitor product movement, and avoid shortages or overstocking. It provides real-time visibility into warehouse operations, improves purchasing decisions, reduces losses, and ensures accurate stock control across all locations for better efficiency and business performance.

Expenses

Expense tracking allows businesses to record, categorize, and analyze all financial spending in one place. It improves financial visibility, helps control budgets, reduces unnecessary costs, and provides clear reports that support better financial planning and smarter business decision-making.

Payroll

Payroll automation simplifies salary processing, tax calculations, deductions, and employee payments. It ensures accuracy, reduces administrative workload, improves compliance, and provides timely and transparent payroll management for businesses of all sizes while increasing efficiency and employee satisfaction.

Sales

Sales management tools help businesses create invoices, track customer transactions, and monitor payments in real time. They improve sales visibility, enhance customer relationships, reduce errors, and provide accurate insights into business performance and revenue growth across all sales channels.

Billing

Billing tools allow businesses to generate supplier bills, manage payments, and track financial obligations efficiently. They improve financial accuracy, reduce manual errors, enhance payment tracking, and provide clear visibility into outstanding liabilities and overall financial health.

🛠 FAQ & Support

Find answers to common questions about inventory management, sales transactions, supplier operations, accounting entries, payroll processing, reporting tools, project tracking, user permissions, integrations, and system settings. Our support resources help users troubleshoot issues, understand platform features, maintain compliance, and optimize workflows. When additional assistance is needed, our dedicated support team is available to provide guidance and ensure uninterrupted business operations.

What is Acacia ERP? An all-in-one platform for inventory, sales, purchases, accounting, payroll, reporting, CRM and business management.

Who can use the system? Businesses of all sizes including retailers, wholesalers, distributors, service providers and growing enterprises.

Can I manage multiple users? Yes, administrators can create users, assign roles and control access permissions.

Does the system support payroll? Yes, including employee records, attendance, deductions, payslips and statutory compliance.

Can I track inventory and shipments? Yes, manage stock levels, movements, pricing, packages and shipment tracking in real time.

How do I upgrade my plan? Contact our support team for subscription upgrades and additional features.

Need assistance? Email: support@acaciabooks.com

💳 Payment Gateway Hub

M-PESA
Visa
Mastercard
Bank Transfer

The Payment Gateway Hub provides secure and flexible transaction options for users within the Acacia Books platform. It supports mobile money payments such as M-PESA, global card networks including Visa and Mastercard, and traditional bank transfers for enterprise-level transactions. This multi-channel payment system ensures accessibility for both local and international users while maintaining secure encrypted processing for all financial operations. Each transaction is logged within the system for accountability, reconciliation, and audit tracking. The module is designed to streamline billing, reduce payment friction, and support seamless financial operations across all business modules.

📜 Legal Hub

  • Terms of Service

    The Terms of Service define the legal agreement between users and the platform. They outline acceptable usage, user responsibilities, system limitations, and service availability. By accessing this system, users agree to comply with operational rules, security requirements, and fair usage policies. The terms also explain account suspension conditions, intellectual property rights, liability limitations, and dispute resolution procedures. This section ensures transparency between the platform and users, protecting both parties from misuse or legal conflicts. Continued use of the system indicates acceptance of all updated terms and conditions.

  • Privacy Policy

    The Privacy Policy explains how user data is collected, stored, processed, and protected within the system. It details what information is gathered, such as account details, activity logs, and system usage patterns, and how this data is used to improve services. The policy ensures compliance with data protection standards and restricts unauthorized sharing of personal information. It also describes encryption methods, retention periods, and user rights regarding data access or deletion. The platform is committed to maintaining confidentiality and safeguarding user trust at all times.

  • Cookie Policy

    The Cookie Policy explains how small data files (cookies) are used to enhance user experience across the platform. Cookies help remember login sessions, user preferences, system settings, and navigation behavior. This allows the system to deliver a more personalized and efficient experience. Users may control or disable cookies through browser settings, although some features may be affected. The policy ensures transparency in tracking technologies and aligns with modern privacy standards. No sensitive financial data is stored directly in cookies.

  • Disclaimer

    The Disclaimer outlines the limitations of liability for the platform regarding accuracy, completeness, and reliability of system data. While every effort is made to ensure information is correct and updated, the system does not guarantee error-free performance. Users are advised to verify critical financial, accounting, or operational outputs before making decisions. The platform is not responsible for indirect losses, data interpretation errors, or third-party integrations. This section ensures users understand system boundaries and risk responsibility.

  • Compliance & Regulations

    The Compliance section ensures that the platform operates under applicable financial, data protection, and business regulations. It aligns system processes with local and international standards such as taxation rules, audit requirements, and reporting obligations. The module ensures that all transactions, records, and logs are maintained in a legally acceptable format. Regular audits and system checks help maintain compliance integrity. Users are responsible for ensuring their business usage follows relevant laws in their jurisdiction.

📩 Request Quote Hub

The Request Quote module allows users to quickly initiate pricing requests for products, services, or custom business requirements. When the “Get Quote” button is activated, a structured quotation form is opened where users can enter details such as item specifications, quantities, delivery expectations, and special conditions. The system then processes this request and routes it to the appropriate sales or procurement team for evaluation. This module improves communication efficiency, reduces manual negotiation delays, and ensures consistent pricing standards across the platform. It is designed for fast, transparent, and trackable business quotations within the system.
